interface.evidence: Original names clk, d, q and all ports one bit; q direction resolved from single D flip-flop requirement.

semantics.edge: On each positive edge of clk, q takes the sampled d value using a nonblocking assignment.
semantics.hold: q retains its sampled value between positive edges, including negative edges.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior appears in the original specification; none is added.
semantics.initialization: No initial value is specified; RTL has no initialization and simulation q is unknown until its first capture.
semantics.latency: q updates in the nonblocking update phase of the same positive clock edge.

numeric.representation: single four-state logic bit; no arithmetic or signed interpretation

verification.oracle: Derived from the original single D flip-flop and positive-edge statements.
verification.sampling: Check after nonblocking updates, using a one-nanosecond settling delay.
verification.completion: Self-checking dev_tb with fatal mismatches, bounded timeout and explicit PASS; fixed dev_check.py initial evaluation.

specification_ambiguities.issue: Original interface lists input q, inconsistent with implementing a single D flip-flop with observable state.
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Use output reg q as the flip-flop state, retaining original port names and one-bit widths.
specification_ambiguities.limitation: Literal input-q direction cannot simultaneously provide the requested flip-flop output.

specification_ambiguities.resolution: Do not add initialization; pre-edge unknown check verifies simulation behavior of the uninitialized implementation, not a promised hardware power-up state.
